user.title: Set up your Marantec garage door
user.description: Enter the code from your remote and choose the RF transmitter that will send it. You can adjust the door timing later under the integration's options.

data_description.code: The 49-bit code from your Marantec remote, as hexadecimal (for example, 130CF7B95865A). You can read it from your existing remote with a Flipper Zero.
data_description.transmitter: The radio-frequency transmitter Home Assistant will use to send the signal, such as an ESPHome device with a CC1101.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your Marantec garage door
reconfigure.description: Update the remote code or the transmitter. Your existing entity, history, and automations are kept.

data_description.code: The 49-bit code from your Marantec remote, as hexadecimal (for example, 130CF7B95865A).
data_description.transmitter: The radio-frequency transmitter used to send the signal.

error.invalid_code: That is not a valid code. Enter the 49-bit value as hexadecimal, for example 130CF7B95865A.

abort.no_transmitters: No compatible RF transmitter was found. Set up a radio-frequency transmitter on 868.35 MHz first, for example an ESPHome device with a CC1101.
abort.already_configured: This remote code is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That code belongs to a different garage door that is already set up.

init.title: Door timing
init.description: Home Assistant cannot sense the door's position, so it estimates the state from these timings. Leave the travel times at 0 to skip the opening and closing phases.

data_description.auto_close_delay: How long the door stays open before it closes itself, measured from the moment it is fully open. Set to 0 to keep it shown as open until reset.
data_description.travel_up: How long the door takes to open. Set to 0 to skip the opening phase.
data_description.travel_down: How long the door takes to close. Set to 0 to skip the closing phase.
